prerequisites.required_decision: Identify the responsible operator, address, offered countries, applicable jurisdictions, minimum age, and contracting capacity.
prerequisites.safe_default: Do not offer accounts, accept uploads, or present hosted terms as active.

prerequisites.required_decision: Select dedicated private privacy, support, security escalation, and legal-notice channels with coverage and backup ownership.
prerequisites.safe_default: Keep hosted privacy requests and real-user support closed.

prerequisites.required_decision: Select the production runtime, immutable deployment mechanism, network boundary, domains, TLS termination, and processing region.
prerequisites.safe_default: Use only the deterministic public Demo with fictional data.

prerequisites.required_decision: Select hosted identity, invite-only allowlisting, verification, recovery, session, MFA/admin, and server-side tenant authorization controls.
prerequisites.safe_default: Disable registration and treat the local session store as development-only.

prerequisites.required_decision: Select production database, object storage if needed, cache, encryption/KMS, backup retention, restoration, and purge behavior.
prerequisites.safe_default: Do not persist real uploads or user-generated content in a hosted service.

prerequisites.required_decision: Verify both relay and underlying model legal entities, terms, DPA, regions, retention, training, human access, abuse monitoring, subprocessors, deletion, and account settings.
prerequisites.safe_default: Keep user-data model calls disabled; local API configuration is not provider due diligence.

prerequisites.required_decision: Select atomic multi-instance counters, trusted client identity, funding cap, provider billing reconciliation, administrative suspension, and external abuse alerting.
prerequisites.safe_default: Keep owner-funded model access closed and retain conservative local limits only as reference behavior.

prerequisites.required_decision: Select durable metrics, independent probes, service-external P0/P1 delivery, status publication, primary/backup coverage, and escalation ownership.
prerequisites.safe_default: Do not describe the manual status file as live monitoring or promise an SLA.

prerequisites.required_decision: Define immutable release promotion, database migration compatibility, rollback target, credential rotation, and recovery notification procedures.
prerequisites.safe_default: Do not deploy or open hosted switches from local validation alone.

prerequisites.required_decision: Recruit authorized participants and two independent target-language reviewers, define scheduling and withdrawal, and keep applicant intake content-free.
prerequisites.safe_default: Accept public expressions of interest only; do not grant access or accept product files.

prerequisites.required_decision: Approve the exact immutable candidate, residual risks, effective legal documents, budget, support coverage, and narrowly capped opening plan after every prerequisite is verified.
